title: The Indian town that bottled the smell of rain: How Kannauj turned rose petals, copper stills and an ancient craft into a global fragrance legacy
description: Regarded as the fragrance hub of India, Kannauj proudly upholds age-old attar manufacturing practices that date back centuries. The traditional hydro distillation process here has origins that surpass those of European perfumery. Crafting high-quality attar demands significant volumes of natural resources. Though the industry faced economic challenges, a renaissance is now blossoming, fueled by government initiatives and a growing global appetite for artisanal scents.

title: When Fossil Industries Retreat, What Happens to the Wage Structures They Leave Behind?
description: Climate policy is designed to cut emissions accelerate clean investment and move economies away from fossil fuels but decarbonization is also dismantling a production model that in many countries shaped wages industrial employment and regional prosperity for decades A new cross-country study suggests those distributional effects may be more deeply rooted in economic structure than in carbon itself

title: 518-million-year-old fossil changes the story of how starfish evolved
